user.title: Connection mode and language
user.description: Choose how the printer is connected and which language the 3D-Printer Control Center dashboard cards should use. Automatic language follows the Home Assistant UI language.

cloud_login.title: Bambu Cloud login
cloud_login.description: The password is used only for login and is not stored. The returned token is stored in the Home Assistant config entry. Cloud access is optional; LAN-only mode works without it.

cloud_code.title: Email verification
cloud_code.description: Enter the verification code sent by Bambu Cloud.

lan.title: LAN connection
lan.description: Enter the printer IP address manually whenever possible. Automatic discovery is available as an optional fallback but is currently a known issue in routed VLAN, VPN and broadcast-restricted networks. Where can I find the device code? On the printer open Settings > LAN Only (on some models under WLAN or Network), enable LAN Only mode and read the IP address and access code shown on that page. Menu placement can differ by printer model and firmware. Use the LAN access code, not a six-digit account PIN.\n\nImportant: The entered printer name is shown on the dashboard if no model name can be detected automatically.

finish.title: AMS and firmware policy
finish.description: Automatic AMS detection is best effort. BMCU-370 can emulate official AMS identifiers, so a manual override remains available. Automatic firmware updates are never enabled.

choose_discovered_host.description: Multiple reachable devices were found. Choose the printer IP address.

init.title: Printer, dashboard and network options
init.description: Choose the dashboard language, set a manual IP address and configure optional network discovery fallback values. Manual IP is recommended while automatic discovery remains a known issue in some VLAN, VPN and broadcast-restricted environments.

scan_network.name: Scan printer network endpoints
scan_network.description: Scan configured endpoints, active TCP peers, ARP neighbors, local discovery, explicit hosts, VLAN CIDRs and small visible route networks. If exactly one valid MQTT endpoint is selected, store it as the active printer IP address.

install_dashboards.name: Install or repair default dashboards
install_dashboards.description: Creates or repairs the two managed default dashboards: 3D printing with integrated queue and 3D printer file manager/gallery.
